entries.summary: # URNetwork Proxy A collection of user-space proxy implementations to bridge URNetwork to other protocols without requiring root privileges.

entries.title: Overview
entries.summary: ## Overview The `proxy` repository provides two implementations: - **socks** A SOCKS5 proxy that routes traffic through URNetwork. - **wg** A WireGuard-based proxy for secure tunneling over URNetwork.
